full_judgment: In the writ petition it was contended, inter alia, that the Fire Service Unit, Rangpur started earth filling on several hundred years old Monthan Pond located adjunct to the Fire Service Station, Rangpur Sadar, Rangpur Containing 1.04 acres of land situated in Mouja Radaballob, Police Station Rangpur Sadar, J.L. No.12 recorded in Khatian No.13801 Plot No.14083 in the name of the respondent No.1 (Government). The original copy of the Khatian lies in the custody of the respondents and the petitioner has managed to obtain a copy of the same.
